_about: Rules library v0. Each requirement is a machine-checkable rule. 'basis' is a plain-English pointer, not legal advice; every rule must be checked by a competent person before customer use. 'max_validity_years' is a plausibility limit: an expiry further away than this is held for a person to check [CHECK the limits with a competent person].

requirements.name: Safety Statement
requirements.basis: Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005, s.20 (written Safety Statement, kept under review)

requirements.name: Employer's liability insurance
requirements.basis: Main contractor subcontract requirement

requirements.name: Public liability insurance
requirements.basis: Main contractor subcontract requirement

requirements.name: Tax clearance (TCAN)
requirements.basis: Revenue tax clearance, requested by main contractors and public clients

requirements.name: Risk assessment and method statement (RAMS)
requirements.basis: Construction Regulations 2013 (contractor duties) and main contractor site rules

requirements.name: SOLAS Safe Pass
requirements.basis: Construction Regulations 2013: Safe Pass required for site workers

requirements.name: CSCS card - Scaffolding
requirements.basis: Construction Regulations 2013: CSCS card for specified tasks

requirements.name: Manual handling training
requirements.basis: General Application Regulations 2007 (manual handling training); required on site by some main contractors

requirements.name: Written terms of employment (signed)
requirements.basis: Terms of Employment (Information) Acts: core terms in writing shortly after starting

requirements.name: Site induction
requirements.basis: Main contractor / PSCS site induction, delivered in a language the worker understands (2005 Act, ss.9-10)

requirements.name: Company details (CRO, VAT, address)
requirements.basis: Main contractor prequalification: company identity (SAMPLE form section A)

requirements.name: Professional indemnity insurance
requirements.basis: Main contractor subcontract requirement where the package includes design (SAMPLE form section B)

requirements.name: Safety certification (Safe-T-Cert or CIRI)
requirements.basis: Main contractor prequalification: independent safety certification or CIRI registration (SAMPLE form section F)

requirements.name: Accident and incident history (last 3 years)
requirements.basis: Main contractor prequalification: declared safety record, reviewed yearly (SAMPLE form section E)

requirements.name: Trade references (2 main contractors)
requirements.basis: Main contractor prequalification: references from recent main contractors (SAMPLE form section H)

requirements.name: CSCS card - 180° Excavator
requirements.basis: Construction Regulations 2013: CSCS card for specified plant (check against Schedule 4)

requirements.name: CSCS card - Site Dumper
requirements.basis: Construction Regulations 2013: CSCS card for specified plant (check against Schedule 4)

requirements.name: CSCS card - Slinger/Signaller
requirements.basis: Construction Regulations 2013: CSCS card for specified tasks (check against Schedule 4)

requirements.name: Thorough examination - lifting equipment
requirements.basis: Lifting equipment used on site must be thoroughly examined by a competent person at set intervals (commonly 12 months) [CHECK interval and scope with a competent person before use]

requirements.name: Thorough examination - lifting accessories
requirements.basis: Lifting accessories (chains, slings, shackles) examined at shorter intervals (commonly 6 months) [CHECK interval and scope with a competent person before use]

requirements.name: Plant service (manufacturer schedule)
requirements.basis: Maintenance to the manufacturer's schedule; service records kept for the plant register [CHECK interval and scope with a competent person before use]

requirements.name: Fire extinguisher service
requirements.basis: Portable fire extinguishers serviced annually by a competent person [CHECK interval and scope with a competent person before use]

requirements.name: Electrical inspection - site cabins and welfare units
requirements.basis: Temporary site electrical installations inspected and tested by a registered electrical contractor [CHECK interval and scope with a competent person before use]

requirements.name: Portable electrical tools test (110V)
requirements.basis: Portable tools on site inspected and tested at regular intervals (commonly every 3 months) [CHECK interval and scope with a competent person before use]

requirements.name: Corrective action
requirements.basis: Raised by a person or from an inspection report; closed only with evidence

requirements.name: Subcontractor public liability insurance
requirements.basis: Your subcontract terms: subcontractors carry their own liability cover

requirements.name: Subcontractor employer's liability insurance
requirements.basis: Your subcontract terms: subcontractors with employees carry employer's liability cover

requirements.name: Subcontractor tax clearance (TCAN)
requirements.basis: Revenue tax clearance for subcontractors you pay (check RCT obligations too)

requirements.name: Subcontractor Safety Statement
requirements.basis: Safety, Health and Welfare at Work Act 2005, s.20 - every employer has a Safety Statement

requirements.name: Subcontractor operatives' Safe Pass register
requirements.basis: Every operative on site holds a current Safe Pass; 'expires' is the earliest card expiry in the register
